body: The crypto market continued to trade in the red, registering a marginal decline over the past 24 hours as macroeconomic uncertainty and geopolitical tensions weighed on investor sentiment. The Federal Reserve’s decision to keep interest rates unchanged also impacted the market, with prices retreating. Bitcoin (BTC) hovered around $105,000 as neither buyers nor sellers could decisively take control. The flagship cryptocurrency fell to a low of $103,695 before recovering and moving to its current levels. However, it is struggling to reclaim $105,000. Ethereum (ETH) remained in the red as well, with the world’s second-largest down nearly 9% over the past week. ETH is currently trading around $2,519 after recovering from a low of $2,469. Ripple (XRP) has been marginally down over the past 24 hours, while Solana (SOL) is down almost 2%, trading around $145. Dogecoin (DOGE) is struggling to stay above $0.170, with the price marginally down, while Cardano (ADA) is down nearly 3%, trading around $0.598. Stellar (XLM) , Toncoin (TON) , Litecoin (LTC) , Hedera (HBAR) , and Polkadot (DOT) also registered substantial declines. However, Chainlink (LINK) bucked the bearish trend, with the price marginally up, trading around $13.10. Fed Keeps Interest Rates Steady The Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady, between 4.25% and 4.50%, expecting elevated inflation and slowed economic growth. However, the Fed expects to make two rate cuts later this year. However, it removed one reduction for 2026 and 2027, putting the expected future rate cuts at four or one percentage point. The Reserve's “dot plot” indicated continued uncertainty about future rate cuts. Each dot represents an official’s expectations for rates. Seven of the nineteen participants indicated they did not want any cuts this year. However, the Committee unanimously approved the policy statement. Economic projections also indicated growing stagflationary pressures, with officials indicating that gross domestic product (GDP) was advancing at 1.4% in 2025 while inflation was hitting 3%. The revised forecasts show a decrease of 0.3 percentage points for GDP and a similar increase for the personal consumption expenditures price index. Core PCE, which eliminates food and energy prices, was projected at 3.1%, 0.3 percentage points higher. Unemployment was up to 4.5%, 0.1 percentage point higher than March and 0.3 percentage point higher than the current level. The FOMC stated, “Uncertainty about the economic outlook has diminished but remains elevated. The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate.” Meanwhile, Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell indicated there was time to wait for more clarity, stating, “For the time being, we are well positioned to wait to learn more about the likely course of the economy before considering any adjustments to our policies.” Iran’s Nobitex Exchange Hacked By Pro-Israel Group Pro-Israel hacker group Gonjeshke Darande has claimed to have destroyed over $90 million stolen from Nobitex’s wallets. The group issued an update stating it had burned the funds across multiple blockchains using “vanity addresses” containing no recoverable private keys. This renders the funds permanently inaccessible. The news comes after the high-profile exploit of Iran’s largest exchange, which saw over $90 million in BTC, ETH, DOGE, and other tokens drained from its hot wallets. The hackers justified the breach as a response to the exchange’s alleged role in helping the Iranian regime circumvent sanctions. The group tied the hack to the ongoing tensions between Israel and Iran, which have intensified following airstrikes on Tehran’s nuclear sites. Blockchain security firm Chainalysis confirmed the stolen assets had not been transferred to crypto mixers or exchanges and were sent to irretrievable addresses with inflammatory labels. Meanwhile, Nobitex acknowledged the burn and assured users their funds were safe in cold storage. The exchange also clarified that its staff had emptied its hot wallets and that no customer funds would be lost thanks to its reserve fund and insurance pool. The increase is a 6.5-fold increase from Circle’s initial public offering price of $31. The legislation cleared the Senate with a 68-30 vote and now heads to the US House of Representatives. House Financial Services Committee staff confirmed that scheduling discussions will begin next week. However, a floor vote date is yet to be decided. Coinbase’s stock also rose 14%, while Robinhood rose 4.5% to reach a new all-time high of $78.35. The market’s reaction to the passage of the GENIUS Act indicates growing confidence that federal oversight could accelerate mainstream adoption and de-risk the regulatory landscape for US-based stablecoin issuers. Trump took to Truth Social to urge the House to “Get it on my desk ASAP.” “The Senate just passed an incredible Bill that is going to make America the UNDISPUTED Leader in Digital Assets. Get it to my desk ASAP — NO DELAYS, NO ADD ONS.” Trump’s message came after the Senate passed the bill 68-30. Supporters of the bill believe it will play a crucial role in maintaining the dollar’s dominance in global finance. Senator Bill Hagerty, also the bill’s sponsor, stated that it would allow businesses of all sizes and Americans across the country to settle payments instantaneously instead of waiting for days or even weeks. The bill faced early setbacks, failing a closure vote in the Senate in May after Democrats voiced concerns about Trump’s connections with the crypto industry. title: Bitcoin scarcity expected to grow as ancient whales' hoarded stockpile peaks
body: Wallets aged over 10 years are driving the scarcity of BTC. Each day, coins marked as long-term storage grow larger compared to newly mined Bitcoins. For the first time, BTC held in long-term supply is growing faster than the supply of newly mined coins. More and more wallets are crossing the 10-year mark with no coins moved, adding to the increasing scarcity of available Bitcoin. The share of ancient supply as a percentage of total BTC supply is near a record, as older holders are unwilling to sell. | Source: Fidelity Digital Assets Satoshi Nakamoto is the original ancient whales While initially intended as electronic cash for daily payments, Bitcoin has turned into a reserve asset. In the past decade, BTC also developed its strong ‘hodl’ ethic, leading to the creation of multiple whale wallets with no intention to sell or move coins. This idle supply was added to the coins held in early miner wallets, including those of Satoshi Nakamoto. Satoshi Nakamoto is the first big holder of wallets older than a decade. Soon after that, the supply of early miners also joined that cohort, reaching new peaks in 2025. Currently, over 566 BTC on average move into the ancient supply category, surpassing the newly mined 450 BTC per day. Over time, a peak 17% or roughly 3.5M coins of Bitcoin supply is now in the long-term holdings of ancient whales, which may not enter circulation again. Over time, the coins locked in ancient stockpiles will only increase. Some of the ancient wallets are relatively small. Currently, there are only 93 wallets with over 10K Bitcoins, as even whales are trying to secure their assets on multiple addresses. More than 2M wallets have over 1,000 BTC . Ancient BTC whales show long-term conviction The ancient supply of BTC contains coins that are considered lost, forgotten, or unmovable for some reason. On very rare occasions, an old wallet will awaken and move or sell some of the coins. However, selling Bitcoins is seen as abandoning the long-term potential of the coin, especially at a time when corporate buyers are scrambling for a dwindling supply of BTC to be locked in treasuries. Bitcoin treasuries are newer, but also hold over 3.39M BTC, catching up with the ancient supply. Scarcity is also driven by other long-term cohorts, including wallets aged 7-10 years and those over five years old. Most of the flux of BTC holdings comes from the earliest wallet cohorts, created under three months ago, as well as from buyers realizing profits from the recent bull market. Some of the whale wallets are specifically engaging in trading, but the overall trend is for even more Bitcoin to become unavailable. Bitcoin daily transactions are at around 440K, near a 12-month low. Currently, on-chain activity is extremely subdued, while traders use the derivative markets to trade “paper BTC.” The expected supply crunch may start affecting the market, as new sources of Bitcoin and willing sellers are getting depleted. Even retail holders have already sold their coins, with significant outflows at much lower prices in the past year. Exchanges and OTC desks are also decreasing their available supply. Unmoved Bitcoin may continue to expand in the coming years, as even 500 BTC would be enough to set up a treasury company. Holders may never sell, instead tapping the value of their Bitcoin through various forms of staking, reserves, or lending. Running Solana Validators: Participating directly in the network’s consensus mechanism. Validators are crucial for processing transactions, securing the blockchain, and earning staking rewards. This dual approach positions them not just as investors, but as active participants in the Solana ecosystem’s health and operation. Seeking a public listing like this suggests they aim to scale their operations and potentially offer broader access to their Solana-focused strategy. Why is a Nasdaq Listing Significant for a Crypto Firm? For a firm deeply involved in cryptocurrency like SOL Strategies, aiming for a listing on a major U.S. exchange like Nasdaq is a substantial step. Nasdaq is one of the world’s leading stock markets, known for listing technology and growth companies. Here’s why this move matters: A Crypto Firm Nasdaq listing brings several potential benefits: Increased Visibility and Credibility: Listing on a regulated, globally recognized exchange lends significant legitimacy compared to being purely a private entity or listed on smaller, less regulated markets. Access to Capital: Public markets provide access to a much larger pool of potential investors, including large institutions that might be restricted from investing directly in crypto assets or private crypto firms. This can fuel growth, expansion, and further investment in their core strategy. Liquidity for Shareholders: A public listing provides liquidity for the firm’s shares, allowing investors to buy and sell more easily. Potential for Institutional Adoption: Listing on Nasdaq could make SOL Strategies an attractive investment vehicle for institutional investors seeking exposure to Solana and the broader crypto space through a familiar, regulated structure. While other crypto-native companies have listed on Nasdaq (like Coinbase), this filing is notable because SOL Strategies’ reported core activity is so specifically tied to a single blockchain ecosystem – Solana – through asset accumulation and validation. Decoding the STKE Nasdaq Ticker The filing indicates SOL Strategies is seeking to list under the proposed ticker symbol STKE Nasdaq Ticker . Ticker symbols are unique abbreviations used to identify publicly traded shares on an exchange. The choice of ‘STKE’ is likely a nod to their staking activities, which are inherent to running Solana validators and potentially part of their yield generation strategy. The process involves filing registration statements with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). This filing is a detailed disclosure document providing information about the company’s business, financials, risks, and the securities being offered. The SEC reviews these filings to ensure they meet regulatory requirements and that investors have access to material information. The process can take time and involves scrutiny from regulators. For potential investors, the STKE ticker would represent shares in SOL Strategies, a company whose performance is tied to its management of Solana assets and validator operations, rather than direct investment in the SOL token itself. This distinction is crucial from a regulatory and investment perspective. SOL Strategies as a Solana Investment Firm The description of SOL Strategies as a Solana Investment Firm highlights their specialized focus. Instead of diversifying across many different cryptocurrencies or blockchain networks, they appear to have chosen Solana as their primary area of expertise and investment. Their strategy of accumulating SOL tokens is a direct investment in the potential growth and adoption of the Solana network. As Solana’s ecosystem expands, transaction volume increases, and demand for blockspace grows, the value of the SOL token could appreciate. Holding a treasury of SOL allows them to benefit from this potential upside. This specialized approach allows them to develop deep expertise in the Solana ecosystem, understanding its technology, community, and market dynamics. It’s a high-conviction play on Solana’s future success. The Critical Role of Solana Validators Running Solana Validators is more than just holding tokens; it’s an operational business activity within the Solana network. Validators are responsible for: Confirming Transactions: Validators verify the legitimacy of transactions on the network. Adding New Blocks: They participate in the consensus mechanism to add new blocks of transactions to the blockchain. Securing the Network: By staking SOL and participating in consensus, they help secure the network against attacks. Earning Rewards: Validators earn rewards (paid in SOL) for their services, typically through transaction fees and protocol-level incentives. For SOL Strategies, running validators provides a potential revenue stream through staking rewards. It also gives them a direct stake (literally) in the network’s performance and governance. It’s an operational business that complements their strategic asset accumulation. This operational component differentiates them from a simple holding company. They are actively contributing to the network’s infrastructure while simultaneously investing in its native asset. What Challenges Might SOL Strategies Face? While the potential benefits are clear, the path to a Nasdaq listing and operating as a public crypto-focused firm is not without hurdles: SEC Approval: The SEC review process is rigorous. They will scrutinize the filing, the business model, and the risks associated with operating in the volatile crypto market. Regulatory clarity around crypto in the U.S. is still evolving, which can add complexity. Market Volatility: The value of SOL and the profitability of validator operations are subject to significant market fluctuations. This volatility will directly impact the firm’s financial performance and share price. Competition: The crypto investment landscape is increasingly competitive, with other funds and firms also focused on specific ecosystems or strategies. Operational Risks: Running validators requires technical expertise and involves risks like slashing (penalties for validator downtime or misbehavior) or security breaches. Public Company Scrutiny: As a public company, SOL Strategies will face increased scrutiny from investors, analysts, and the media regarding its performance, strategy, and governance. Successfully navigating these challenges will be key to their long-term success as a publicly traded entity. Potential Impact on the Solana Ecosystem and Crypto Market If SOL Strategies successfully lists on Nasdaq, what could it mean? Increased Exposure for Solana: A publicly traded company focused on Solana could draw more traditional finance attention to the network. New Investment Vehicle: It could offer traditional investors a regulated way to get exposure to Solana’s growth without directly buying and holding SOL tokens or running validators themselves. Precedent for Other Crypto Firms: A successful listing could pave the way for other specialized crypto firms or even decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) (in some form) to explore public market access, potentially bridging the gap between traditional finance and specific blockchain ecosystems. This move signifies the continued maturation and institutionalization of the crypto space, with firms seeking familiar structures to engage with broader capital markets. What Should Investors and Solana Enthusiasts Watch For? Keep an eye on the SEC’s review process. The S-1 filing (or equivalent) will provide more detailed information about SOL Strategies’ financials, risks, and exact strategy. The timeline for approval is uncertain but will be a key indicator. Also, observe how the market reacts if and when STKE begins trading. Its performance could serve as a barometer for traditional investor appetite for specialized, ecosystem-focused crypto companies. Summary: Bridging Crypto Ambition and Traditional Markets SOL Strategies’ pursuit of a Nasdaq listing under the proposed ticker ‘STKE’ is a significant development. As a Solana Investment Firm actively accumulating SOL and running Solana Validators , they represent a specific, operational approach to participating in the crypto economy. A successful SOL Strategies Nasdaq Listing would position them as one of the few publicly traded entities offering investors exposure to a strategy so closely tied to a single blockchain ecosystem. This move by a Crypto Firm Nasdaq bound highlights the ongoing convergence of traditional finance and decentralized technology, potentially opening new avenues for investment and bringing increased visibility to the Solana network and the role of participants like validators. The journey through SEC approval and the eventual market reception of the STKE Nasdaq Ticker will be closely watched by those interested in the evolving landscape of crypto investment. title: Urgent Upbit SEI Suspension: Network Upgrade Impacts Deposits
body: BitcoinWorld Urgent Upbit SEI Suspension: Network Upgrade Impacts Deposits Attention Upbit users and SEI holders! A crucial announcement from one of South Korea’s largest cryptocurrency exchanges requires your immediate attention if you deal with the SEI coin . What’s Happening with Upbit SEI Suspension? Upbit, a prominent Upbit crypto exchange in the global market, has officially informed its users about a temporary halt in services related to the Sei network. Specifically, the exchange will be suspending both deposits and withdrawals of SEI coin . This measure is scheduled to take effect on June 20 at 09:00 Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) . It’s important to mark this time and date if you plan any transactions involving SEI on the Upbit platform. Why is Upbit Suspending SEI Services? The reason behind this temporary disruption is the upcoming SEI network upgrade . Blockchain network upgrades are significant events that often require exchanges and other service providers to pause related activities to ensure a smooth transition and the safety of user funds. Think of it like scheduled maintenance on a major highway. You temporarily close sections to improve them, which causes short-term inconvenience but leads to better performance and safety in the long run. Similarly, a SEI network upgrade aims to bring improvements to the Sei blockchain, such as enhanced performance, security, or new features. During such upgrades, exchanges typically suspend crypto deposit withdrawal services for the affected asset to prevent potential issues like: Deposits or withdrawals getting lost due to incompatible blockchain versions. Incorrect balances being reflected post-upgrade. Technical glitches during the transition period. This proactive step by Upbit is standard practice across the industry to protect user assets and maintain the integrity of the trading platform during network transitions. What Should Upbit SEI Holders Do? If you hold SEI coin on Upbit or plan to deposit or withdraw it, here are some actionable insights: Plan Ahead: If you need to deposit or withdraw SEI, make sure to complete your transactions well before the June 20, 09:00 UTC deadline. Stay Informed: Keep a close eye on Upbit’s official announcements. The exchange will notify users when the network upgrade is successfully completed and when deposit and withdrawal services for SEI will resume. Consider Alternatives (Temporarily): If urgent SEI transactions are needed after the suspension begins, you may need to explore other exchanges that support SEI and are not undergoing a suspension during that specific period (after verifying their status). However, remember that transferring assets between exchanges also takes time. The Upbit SEI suspension is temporary, but being prepared is key to avoiding any inconvenience. Understanding the Impact of a SEI Network Upgrade While the temporary suspension might be inconvenient, the underlying reason – the SEI network upgrade – is generally a positive development for the Sei ecosystem. Upgrades are necessary for blockchain networks to evolve, adapt to new challenges, and implement community-approved proposals. For the SEI coin and its network, this upgrade likely aims to enhance its capabilities as a Layer 1 blockchain optimized for trading. Improved speed, lower transaction costs, or new functionalities could be among the benefits derived from the upgrade, potentially strengthening the Sei network in the long term. When Will Upbit SEI Services Resume? Upbit has stated the suspension is temporary. Services will resume once the SEI network upgrade is complete and the exchange has confirmed the stability and compatibility of their systems with the upgraded network. There is typically a period of monitoring and verification after an upgrade before exchanges reopen deposits and withdrawals. Users should monitor Upbit’s official channels for the announcement regarding the resumption time. Summary: Navigating the Upbit SEI Suspension In summary, the Upbit SEI suspension of deposits and withdrawals is a temporary measure starting June 20, 09:00 UTC, enacted by the Upbit crypto exchange in anticipation of a crucial SEI network upgrade . This is a standard procedure to safeguard assets and ensure system compatibility. Users are advised to complete any necessary crypto deposit withdrawal operations for SEI before the deadline and monitor Upbit’s official communications for updates on service resumption. While inconvenient in the short term, the network upgrade itself is a positive step for the SEI coin and its underlying technology. title: NATIX Network Launches DePAI Initiative, Merging DePIN Infrastructure with Decentralized AI
body: June 19th, 2025 – Hamburg, Germany NATIX Network unveils its Decentralized Physical Artificial Intelligence (DePAI) strategy, integrating community-powered data collection from smartphones and Teslas with real-time AI model development for smart cities and autonomous systems. NATIX Network , a pioneer in Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN), has officially announced its expansion into Decentralized Physical Artificial Intelligence ( DePAI ). This initiative represents a significant evolution in how artificial intelligence systems are trained and powered—by replacing traditional, centralized datasets with real-time, community-sourced data streams from smartphones and vehicles. The NATIX Network currently spans more than 255,000 contributors across 170+ countries, who have collectively mapped over 181 million kilometers. This crowdsourced geospatial data is collected through NATIX’s two flagship platforms: the Drive& smartphone app and the VX360 device for Tesla vehicles. “The rise of Physical AI requires more than smart algorithms—it demands real-world data diversity at scale,” said Alireza Ghods, CEO of NATIX. “With our community-driven DePIN infrastructure, we’re building the foundation for decentralized AI training that’s inclusive, adaptive, and privacy-conscious.” The Drive& app turns ordinary smartphones into AI data collectors by detecting traffic events, road signs, pedestrians, and infrastructure anomalies. This Smartphone DePIN approach has made it easy for everyday users to contribute valuable street-level metadata while earning rewards in NATIX, the network’s native token. For higher-fidelity applications, the recently launched VX360 device integrates directly with Tesla’s built-in camera systems to capture 360-degree driving footage, thus creating Tesla DePIN . This data is particularly useful for simulation-based scenario generation in autonomous vehicle (AV) development and real-time mapping updates. To enable contributors and developers alike, NATIX leverages DePIN Crypto to reward users and support decentralized governance. The NATIX token operates with deflationary mechanics, including monthly token burns and buybacks—totaling over 318.1 million tokens removed from circulation to date. By pairing this token economy with its global data stream, NATIX is empowering a wide range of AI applications, from AV safety testing and urban infrastructure monitoring to advanced map-making and autonomous robotics. “Decentralized infrastructure is no longer an experiment—it’s live, operational, and scaling fast,” Ghods added. “With DePAI, we’re turning everyday drives into datasets that train the next generation of autonomous cars and robots.” As the physical and digital worlds converge, NATIX believes the future of AI will be built not in isolated labs, but through widespread public participation. The DePAI strategy exemplifies this vision by combining token incentives, decentralized hardware, and real-time data processing into one cohesive system. About NATIX Network: NATIX Network is a decentralized mapping and AI infrastructure provider built on the principles of DePIN. Its ecosystem includes the Drive& smartphone app, the VX360 Tesla device, and the NATIX token. With contributors in over 170 countries, NATIX powers real-time geospatial data collection for AI model training, scenario simulation, and next-generation mobility services. title: Is This the Start of a $2T Stablecoin Revolution?
body: Coinbase (COIN) and Circle (CRCL) stocks exploded on Wednesday, surging 16.3% and 33.8% respectively, after the U.S. Senate passed the GENIUS Act—a landmark bill creating the first federal framework for stablecoins. “History is being made. The GENIUS Act will drive U.S. economic competitiveness for decades.” — Jeremy Allaire, Circle CEO The 68-30 vote marks a seismic shift for crypto regulation, validating Wall Street’s bet that clear rules could unlock a $2 trillion stablecoin market within a decade. What’s Inside the GENIUS Act? The bill's strongest provisions are already starting to change the industry. Stablecoins must now be 1:1 collateralized with cash or short-term Treasuries, so that every token can be fully redeemed and the risk of undercollateralized runs is eliminated. Issuers like Circle will need to disclose monthly public audits of their reserves, giving investors unprecedented disclosure. For the first time, issuers of stablecoins will be directly subject to the jurisdiction of the Treasury and OCC to license and supervise, alongside banks. And in a move welcomed by tech developers, the bill mandates interoperability standards, bringing stablecoins out of their insular blockchain environments to exchange freely between them. Trading Frenzy The market reacted quickly and dramatically. Circle's volume spiked to 4.5 million shares—three times its 30-day average—as the stock rose to a high of $200.90, up a jaw-dropping 500% from its June 5 IPO price. Coinbase added $4.5 billion in market cap in the meantime, as options traders bought up bets that the stock would reach $350 by July. The ripple effect was cross-industry: Robinhood jumped 4.5%, and PayPal and Block declined, as investors rebalanced their bets on whose payment rails will dominate in a stablecoin world. ”Stablecoin Summer” Analysts disagree on whether this ”stablecoin summer” will spill over into spot token prices. Some, like Bernstein, assume stablecoin growth brings fresh liquidity into the crypto system, traditionally a harbinger of Bitcoin upswings. On-chain observations already show USDC supply jumping 22% as stocks fell last week, pointing to traders rotating capital into regulated stablecoins. Others caution that Tether (USDT) is still the ruler with a 70% market share, and the GENIUS Act does not talk about other macro headwinds like Fed policy. An essential metric to follow is USDC payment adoption. Coinbase's fresh Shopify integration now makes it possible for merchants to settle stablecoin payments, a change that can shake up Visa and Mastercard's dominance of e-commerce. What's Next The bill's ride is not over yet. It now heads to the House, where the competitor STABLE Act—with tighter state-level regulation—may muddy the path to final passage. Political dawdling is to be expected, as House Republicans demand combining GENIUS with broader crypto market structure reforms. Another area of disagreement: both bills ban interest-bearing retail stablecoins, adding to a substantial source of income for issuers and potentially limiting consumer demand. The Bottom Line Senate approval of the GENIUS Act is more than a regulatory milestone—it's a force transforming crypto's role in the mainstream financial universe. For investors, the stablecoin rally could hinge on House negotiations and real-world adoption. One thing's for sure: Wall Street is betting big on the promise of ”stablecoin summer.”

PayPal: Stablecoin Will Power Growth
body: Summary PayPal's recent share price weakness is overblown; entrenched merchant relationships and Fastlane checkout innovation support its core franchise and growth prospects. PYUSD stablecoin is a major catalyst, offering regulatory advantages, APY yield, and the potential to boost net income by $4 billion if PayPal captures 20% market share. Valuation is attractive: PayPal trades below historical averages despite superior cash flow growth, offering investors significant upside if multiples expand. Risks from competitors and stablecoin adoption exist, but regulatory positioning and network effects make PayPal a strong buy with asymmetric upside over 12-24 months. Co-Authored by Noah Cox and Brock Heilig Investment Thesis Shares of PayPal Holdings, Inc. ( PYPL ) have had a rough first half of 2025. Year-to-date, shares of the financial technology company are down nearly 17%. With the rise of stablecoins the reasons for PayPal’s underperformance have been due to fears that Apple Pay and Shopify are encroaching on PayPal’s checkout share along with stablecoins encroaching on their payment processing fees. With this, however, I really believe that these concerns are overstated. PayPal has entrenched merchant relationships and high-conversion funnels. I want to focus on management’s “ win checkout ” push for 2025 - particularly the Fastlane one-click guest checkout launched in early 2024, which I wrote about extensively during my last piece of coverage on PayPal. I view this as a direct effort to streamline purchases and defend PayPal’s core franchise. I believe that PayPal’s vast network of over 400 million accounts between both consumers and merchants creates durable scale advantages that are hard for new entrants like Apple Pay and Shopify to replicate. In my opinion, there is promising optionality in PayPal’s growth stories - most notably crypto - highlighted by the 2023 rollout of the PYUSD stablecoin, which could help lower transaction costs and open new rails for payments. With legislation moving through Washington DC that promises regulations for Stablecoins, this could be a huge catalyst. PayPal should benefit. With this, I continue to believe shares are a strong buy. Why I’m Doing Follow-Up Coverage Since I published my last coverage on PayPal, shares of the company dipped by as much as 21%, but they have since rebounded, and they’re down just about 2% since late February when I last published coverage on PayPal. I think most of this recent selloff has been driven by Apple Pay and Shopify fears, echoing mid-2022 worries that ultimately proved unfounded when Apple integrated PayPal as a checkout option. I’ve seen anecdotal bear arguments gain some traction, but I think these are isolated and are definitely not reflective of PayPal’s broad merchant base. Something that keeps me bullish on PayPal heading into the rest of the year is CEO Alex Chriss's relentless focus on winning back market share as his top priority. Fastlane is a big part of this story. With this, early metrics continue to reassure me. As noted on the Q4 call : 75% of Fastlane consumers are new or dormant PayPal users. This means that Fastlane not only improves conversion for our merchants, but also introduces more shoppers to PayPal and enables us to reengage in active users. With the growth of their stablecoin + stronger regulatory backing in DC for stablecoin, I think this makes now a perfect time to revisit PayPal. I believe the recent pullback is just short-term noise. I think the bull case is accelerating. Stablecoin Deep Dive To understand why Stablecoins are a big deal for PayPal, I want to focus on PayPal USD and why this is such a big development for PayPal. PayPal USD (or PYUSD) was launched in August 2023 as the first US-backed stablecoin from a major fintech company. The stablecoin was issued via Paxos Trust , is fully collateralized by dollar deposits and U.S. treasuries, and is pegged 1:1 to the U.S. dollar. With growing adoption (and a more favorable environment in DC) we’ve seen a trend begin to develop where stablecoins are being brought into mainstream payments. PYUSD is being integrated across both PayPal and Venmo for P2P transfers, Xoom remittances, and third-party wallet payments. The goal here is to leverage blockchain rails to undercut card network fees and settlement times. I think PayPal’s 400 million+ user base and merchant integrations give PYUSD a huge distribution edge in both commerce use cases and remittances - both of which are situations where crypto-native stablecoins have struggled to gain traction. To add to this, in April 2025, PayPal partnered with Coinbase to waive fees on PYUSD buys and sells and enable one-click conversion to USD. In the future, I expect the roadmap to enable merchants to settle directly in PYUSD. This could be huge and help eliminate fees with cross-border transactions. PayPal plans to roll out a 3.7% APY yield on PYUSD balances in PayPal and Venmo wallets starting in the summer. What this means is that it will make holding PYUSD materially more attractive than cash or rival stablecoins. I view PYUSD as a catalyst for seriously accelerating the amount of cash PayPal holds on its balance sheet that it can generate interest on. In a way, PayPal becomes closer to a bank, which could have huge implications on net income margins. The potential for this market could be huge, with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent estimating that the TAM of stablecoins could exceed $2 Trillion in just a few years. If PayPal grabbed a 20% market share with its stablecoin ($400 billion) and then made a 1% net income margin spread on it ($4 billion) this could go a long way to increasing their bottom line. Valuation Currently, PayPal has a forward non-GAAP price-to-earnings ratio of 13.88 . This is a 33.85% premium to fintech/financial peers, with the sector median currently sitting at 10.37. However, this 13.88 P/E ratio by PayPal is more than 51% below the company’s five-year average of 28.66. Seeking Alpha Quant gives PayPal a grade of D+ on this metric. PayPal’s forward price-to-book ratio of 3.22 is almost 196% higher than the sector median of 1.09. Meanwhile, similar to their forward price-to-earnings ratio, this mark is about 50% below the five-year average for PayPal. The company earns a grade of a D- on this metric. In my opinion, these two metrics reflect PayPal’s profitability. The market still values the company at a higher multiple than a traditional bank (more tech-savvy) but not as high as other fintech leaders. Interestingly, PayPal’s forward projected operating cash flow growth rate of 20.12% is more than double the sector median of 10.04%. This is given a grade of B+ by Seeking Alpha Quant. In essence, the company trades at a 33.85% premium to the sector median on a forward P/E ratio yet has forwarded cash flow growth that is projected to be more than double the sector median over the next 12 months (4 quarters). In essence, I think the company’s forward P/E ratio should be at least a 60% premium to the sector median given this well above sector median growth. If we saw their P/E premium expand to a 60% premium, this would represent a 77.25% upside from here. We get this upside by taking the projected premium (60% premium) and dividing it by the current premium (33.85%). Frankly, I think even this 60% premium may turn out to be conservative. If we price in an additional $4 billion in net income from a 20% market share in the stablecoin market, I think this will make their cash flow growth even stronger than expected. Risks PayPal (despite their share price performance) should be a winner from the stablecoin revolution. That doesn’t mean they are risk-free. The biggest risk from the stablecoin revolution, in my opinion, is the intense fintech competition. I see Stripe’s global stablecoin push (their Bridge acquisition) and Apple/Shopify checkout integrations as credible threats to PayPal’s market share and fee-take rates. Another risk I see is how ingrained some early movers are. It’s clear to me that USDC and USDT have cemented themselves as leaders. Switching would require clear benefits (their account yield of 3.7% APY may accomplish this). The other benefit is that PayPal is going down the regulatory-sanctioned route for stablecoins. This means that as USDC and USDT (run by Tether) are subject to more audits, we should see the benefits of building a stablecoin with regulations in mind as a key strategic edge. There have been industry rumors that some stablecoins like Tether are not 1:1 backed by liquid assets. What we are about to find (thanks to the stablecoin act called the GENIUS Act) is that stablecoins are about to become a market where participants (stablecoin issuers) ask for regulatory permission. Not regulatory forgiveness. Most of the finance works this way. As stablecoins move this way as well, PayPal should benefit. Bottom Line While shares have slumped year to date I remain confident in PayPal. I think they’ve established themselves as a trusted brand with high-conversion checkout funnels and two-sided network effects. I think these things underpin what, I think, is its durable digital-payments leadership and path to serious growth in the stablecoin space. I view PYUSD as a long-term growth engine. If mainstream stablecoin usage takes off within PayPal’s ecosystem, it could meaningfully lower processing costs and deepen engagement. I think most of the bearish concerns are coming from Apple/Shopify/Braintree headwinds, but I think all of these are manageable and are largely priced in. This sets a low bar for positive surprises in 2025-26. I think stablecoins are the biggest part of the bull thesis. Stablecoins have the opportunity to be a $4 billion lift to net income alone just on effective net interest income margins. I think the valuation is supported by really durable cash flow, which makes for a scenario where investors effectively get optional upside from new initiatives “for free” on top of the stable core business. If management can successfully execute checkout innovation and stablecoin adoption, I still consider PayPal to be a strong buy with asymmetric upside over the next 12-24 months. The market appears to be irrational. This should be a gift to patient investors.

title: Jerome Powell Attacked: Trump Launches Furious Blast at Federal Reserve Chair
body: BitcoinWorld Jerome Powell Attacked: Trump Launches Furious Blast at Federal Reserve Chair In the often-unpredictable world where politics collides with economic policy, recent comments from Donald Trump regarding Jerome Powell , the current Chair of the Federal Reserve , have certainly grabbed headlines. For those navigating the volatile waters of cryptocurrency, understanding these high-level economic and political tensions is crucial, as they can ripple through the broader US economy and influence market sentiment, including digital assets. Why is Donald Trump Attacking Jerome Powell? Former President Donald Trump took to his Truth Social platform to unleash sharp criticism directed at Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell . The language used was notably harsh, labeling Powell as “Too Late—Powell,” “the WORST,” and even “a real dummy.” Trump asserted that Powell’s actions were costing the United States billions of dollars. This isn’t the first time Trump has publicly criticized Powell. During his presidency, Trump frequently attacked the Fed Chair, particularly over decisions related to interest rates . Trump consistently advocated for lower rates, often clashing with the Fed’s mandate for independent monetary policy focused on stable prices and maximum employment. The recent attack also included Trump sharing an article that specifically called for Powell’s resignation. The article reportedly originated from sources associated with Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, key players in the country’s mortgage lending sector. The Federal Reserve’s Latest Move on Interest Rates Adding another layer to this story, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the principal monetary policymaking body of the Federal Reserve , recently concluded its meeting with a significant announcement: interest rates would remain unchanged. This decision comes at a time when the US economy is grappling with various factors, including inflation concerns, employment data, and global economic uncertainties. The Fed’s strategy has been to use interest rates as a tool to manage economic growth and inflation. Keeping rates steady signals the Fed’s current assessment of the economic landscape, which appears to be at odds with Trump’s critical view. Key points from the Fed’s position: Maintaining the current target range for the federal funds rate. Monitoring incoming economic data to guide future decisions. Aiming for maximum employment and inflation at the 2 percent longer-run goal. Acknowledging that economic outlook remains uncertain. Understanding the Impact on the US Economy Attacks on the Federal Reserve Chair and calls for resignation introduce political uncertainty into economic policy discussions. While the Fed operates independently, political pressure can still influence public perception and potentially market reactions. The Fed’s decisions on interest rates directly affect borrowing costs for consumers and businesses, influencing everything from mortgage rates to corporate investments. Lower rates can stimulate borrowing and spending, potentially boosting the US economy but risking higher inflation. Higher rates can curb inflation but may slow down economic growth. Challenges and Considerations: Balancing inflation control with economic growth. Navigating global economic headwinds. Managing market expectations regarding future rate changes. Maintaining the perceived independence of the Federal Reserve from political influence. How Does This Affect Crypto Investors? While seemingly a political squabble about traditional finance, tensions surrounding Jerome Powell and the Federal Reserve ‘s policies have indirect but important implications for cryptocurrency markets: Macroeconomic Sentiment: Uncertainty in the traditional US economy can sometimes drive investors towards alternative assets like Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, viewing them as potential hedges against inflation or economic instability. Interest Rate Environment: The Fed’s stance on interest rates impacts the liquidity in the financial system. Lower rates generally make riskier assets (like crypto) more attractive compared to lower-yield traditional investments. Higher rates can pull capital away from risk assets. Dollar Strength: Fed policy influences the strength of the U.S. dollar. A weaker dollar can sometimes make dollar-denominated assets like Bitcoin more appealing to international buyers. Regulatory Landscape: Political pressure on economic institutions can sometimes spill over into discussions about regulating emerging asset classes like cryptocurrencies. Actionable Insight: Stay informed about the Federal Reserve ‘s announcements and general macroeconomic trends. While crypto markets have unique drivers, they are not entirely insulated from the broader financial system and political climate surrounding figures like Jerome Powell and Donald Trump . Conclusion: Navigating Uncertainty The recent, fierce criticism from Donald Trump towards Jerome Powell highlights ongoing political tensions surrounding the leadership and policies of the Federal Reserve . Despite these attacks, the Fed’s FOMC has maintained its course, keeping interest rates unchanged in response to its assessment of the US economy . This dynamic interplay between political rhetoric and independent monetary policy creates a layer of uncertainty. For those involved in cryptocurrency, understanding these macroeconomic signals and the potential impacts of political pressure on institutions like the Federal Reserve is vital for making informed decisions in an interconnected global market. title: Iran Imposes Crypto Exchange Curfew After $100M Nobitex Hack
body: Iran’s central bank has imposed strict operating hours on domestic cryptocurrency exchanges following a devastating $100 million exploit on Nobitex, the country’s largest digital asset platform. The attack, reportedly carried out by a pro-Israel hacker group, has prompted a swift government response aimed at reducing the risk of further cyber intrusions. According to blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis, the new curfew limits exchanges to functioning only between 10 a.m. and 8 p.m. local time. Andrew Fierman, head of national security intelligence at Chainalysis, recently stated that the move likely aims to contain the potential damage of future incidents. “Incidents are easier to triage if they’re not happening in the middle of the night,” he noted. The Nobitex hack occurred early Wednesday morning , during off-peak hours. Chainalysis also suggested that the Iranian government may be using the curfew to tighten control over citizen transactions, especially in a time of high geopolitical tension and the risk of capital flight. This is not the first time Iran has restricted crypto activity—last December, authorities shut down all exchanges temporarily to stabilize the rial. Pro-Israel Hackers Burned the Stolen Crypto The hacking group Gonjeshke Darande claimed responsibility for infiltrating Nobitex’s systems and draining its hot wallets of major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin, XRP, and Solana. Chainalysis reported that the stolen funds were sent to burner wallets—addresses with no private key access—effectively removing the assets from circulation. “This attack stands out not just for its size but for its motive,” Fierman said. “Unlike typical hacks motivated by profit, this one appears politically driven, intended to deprive the Iranian regime of access to funds.” Nobitex, which facilitates more than $11 billion in inflows—far surpassing any other Iranian exchange—has acknowledged the breach. In a statement on X, the platform said it has severed all external access to its servers and moved remaining funds from hot wallets to secure cold storage. Nobitex Struggles to Restore Access Although Nobitex claims the situation is under control, user access remains suspended. The exchange confirmed that its Reserve Fund will cover all losses incurred in the breach. However, it warned that ongoing internet disruptions and additional security protocols may delay the restoration of full services. As a key player in Iran’s crypto space, Nobitex’s compromise could have ripple effects throughout the region. Chainalysis highlighted its role in facilitating global crypto access for Iranian users—many of whom are otherwise cut off from international financial systems. title: Here’s Why XRP Is About to Break the Tension Soon
body: According to a prominent analyst, XRP is approaching an important moment as major signals converge to indicate a possible breakout. Specifically, amid XRP's current price struggles at the lower end of the $2 price region, the 1-day chart shared by analyst Dark Defender shows XRP forming a tight squeeze at the intersection of multiple important indicators. XRP Sees a Confluence of Major IndicatorsThese include a descending resistance trendline, Fibonacci retracement levels, the Ichimoku Cloud, a cup pattern, and clustered Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs). All these elements are moving to a high-confluence zone that could trigger a major price move in the days ahead.The chart begins in January 2025 when XRP reached a local peak of $3.4 and retraced. Following that high, XRP entered a downward trajectory that continued until April, creating the base of a cup formation at a low of $1.61 on April 7.This cup has been developing for months, gradually arching upward, and now XRP trades near the cup's rim. Notably, the rim is the area often referred to as the surface of the pattern. This surface aligns with major resistance and is where several other important indicators now converge. XRP 1D Chart | Dark Defender Another prominent indicator is the descending trendline, which began after the January peak. Importantly, this line has capped multiple price rallies and still acts as a ceiling to upward movement. At the time of reporting, XRP has returned to this resistance level, but this time, it does so while supported by other bullish patterns. XRP Ichimoku Cloud, EMAs, and Fib RetracementsAnother indicator is the Ichimoku Cloud, which dominates a portion of the chart from February through June. Right now, the price is trading inside the cloud. Typically, being inside the cloud suggests indecision, with neither bulls nor bears holding control. However, the cloud in this case is very thin around the current price, which often signals an imminent breakout. Thin clouds provide little resistance or support, making them ideal zones for swift moves once the price escapes either side. As XRP tests this area, the Ichimoku structure bolsters the overall tension.Meanwhile, adding to the pressure is the tight clustering of EMAs. Several EMAs are nearly overlapping in the current range. Notably, such compression often precedes sharp price volatility, as the market coils before releasing energy in one direction.In addition, Dark Defender referenced the Fibonacci retracement levels measured from the January high. Currently trading for $2.16, XRP sits below the 61.8% retracement at $2.1958 and the 70.2% level at $2.2895. Just below its current price position lies the 50% retracement at $2.0706, which acts as a strong support level. The confluence of all these signals - the descending resistance line, the narrow Ichimoku Cloud , the Fibonacci levels, the cup pattern structure, and the tight EMA bands - translates to an imminent release of tension, and Dark Defender expects this to occur soon.Specifically, the market analyst identified immediate targets at $2.22 and $3.61, while pointing to $2.0706 as a key support. He suggested that the cup is now "hot," and market participants should prepare themselves for a decision soon. At its current price, XRP must rise 67% to claim $3.61.

XRP Ledger Embraces Decentralized Government With Latest Announcement
body: The XRP Ledger (XRPL) is entering a new chapter in its evolution with the upcoming launch of XAO DAO, its first decentralized, community-led governance organization. As reported by Cointelegraph, this groundbreaking initiative will empower XRP holders to take the lead in shaping the network’s future through direct participation in proposals, funding grants, and executing on-chain decisions using the native XRP token. A Major Shift Toward Community Governance XAO DAO introduces a formal governance framework that gives the community meaningful control over XRPL’s direction. Rather than relying solely on foundational entities or corporate influence, the DAO will allow individual XRP holders to propose ideas, vote on initiatives, and implement changes entirely on-chain. BREAKING: XRP Ledger embraces decentralized governance with upcioming launch of XAO DAO, its first community-led organization to drive proposals, grants, and on-chain decision-making using $XRP . pic.twitter.com/J54qjju9WM — Cointelegraph (@Cointelegraph) June 19, 2025 Built to support transparency, resilience, and decentralization, XAO DAO will manage funding for community-driven projects and coordinate improvements across the ecosystem. This marks a clear departure from XRPL’s earlier governance model and reflects a growing demand for blockchain networks to embrace democratic and decentralized decision-making. The Road to XAO DAO: Years in the Making This development didn’t emerge overnight. In September 2024, XRPL Labs revealed that Ripple, XRPL Commons, and other contributors had begun collaborating on decentralized governance frameworks. By the end of that month, the XRPL Foundation had publicly signaled its intent to support community-led bodies through GitHub updates and technical proposals. David Bchiri, president of XRPL Commons, described the vision in an interview with Web3 Deep Dive, outlining a structure that includes an independent board, rotating committee members, and transparent voting systems. These early efforts laid the foundation for what is now materializing as XAO DAO—a legally structured, community-empowered arm of XRPL governance. Strengthening Infrastructure and Legal Foundations The shift toward community governance is also aligned with broader reforms across the XRPL ecosystem. In early 2025, XRPL validators were advised to migrate to a new Unique Node List (UNL) under a restructured XRPL Foundation. This new framework includes XRPL Commons, XRPL Labs, Ripple, and now XAO DAO as its four pillars. This ensures oversight through a General Assembly and an independent board, while embedding community representation at its core. These structural changes are designed to increase trust, reduce centralization risks, and make governance more transparent for all network participants. What It Means for the XRP Community The announcement confirms that XAO DAO will launch soon, with a waitlist already open for early participants. Once live, the DAO will offer XRP holders the tools to directly influence development decisions, allocate funding for promising projects, and vote on major network upgrades. As DAOs continue to gain traction across the crypto world, XRPL is taking a bold step to stay at the forefront of decentralized innovation. By enabling secure, on-chain voting and structured community input, XAO DAO promises to accelerate XRPL’s growth while reinforcing its core values of openness and decentralization. A New Governance Era Begins With XAO DAO on the horizon, the XRP Ledger is no longer just a payment protocol—it’s now a living, evolving ecosystem shaped by the very people who use and build on it. This governance milestone signals XRPL’s readiness to compete not just as a blockchain, but as a fully decentralized, self-sustaining network. title: Ethereum ETF Inflows Soar: US Spot ETH ETFs Record $19.1M on June 18
body: BitcoinWorld Ethereum ETF Inflows Soar: US Spot ETH ETFs Record $19.1M on June 18 Are you watching the crypto market, especially the developments around US spot ETH ETFs ? There’s exciting news from June 18, as these newly launched investment products experienced their third consecutive day of net inflows, bringing in a combined $19.1 million. This trend signals growing investor interest and provides valuable insights into the market’s sentiment towards Ethereum. Understanding the Significance of US Spot ETH ETFs Before diving into the numbers, let’s quickly touch on why US spot ETH ETFs are such a big deal. These exchange-traded funds hold actual Ethereum (ETH) as their underlying asset, offering traditional investors exposure to the second-largest cryptocurrency without needing to directly buy, store, or manage ETH themselves. This simplifies investment and opens the door for broader participation from both retail and institutional investors. The approval and subsequent launch of these funds in the U.S. are considered a major milestone for the crypto industry, similar to the impact of spot Bitcoin ETFs earlier in the year. They provide a regulated and accessible pathway into the Ethereum ecosystem, potentially increasing liquidity and market maturity. Breaking Down the Latest ETF Inflows According to data compiled by Farside Investors, June 18 saw a solid performance for ETF inflows into the U.S. spot Ethereum funds. Here’s a quick look at the breakdown: Total Net Inflow: $19.1 million Leading Fund (BlackRock’s ETHA): $15.1 million net inflow Second Leading Fund (Grayscale’s mini ETH): $4 million net inflow Other Funds: Reported no change in holdings for the day. This data highlights BlackRock’s ETHA as a dominant player early on, capturing the lion’s share of the day’s inflows. Grayscale’s mini ETH, which is a spin-off from its larger Grayscale Ethereum Trust (ETHE), also saw positive movement. Why Does a Third Consecutive Day of Inflows Matter for the ETH Price? Observing a trend is often more insightful than looking at a single day’s data. The fact that June 18 marks the third straight day of net inflows for Ethereum ETF products is significant. It suggests that the initial outflows from Grayscale’s primary ETHE fund, which often occur as investors arbitrage or switch to lower-fee options, might be stabilizing or being offset by fresh capital entering the ecosystem via these new ETFs. Consistent inflows can be interpreted as a positive signal for the market. It indicates sustained buying pressure through these investment vehicles, which could potentially have a positive impact on the underlying ETH price over time, assuming the trend continues and scales up. While $19.1 million might seem modest compared to some Bitcoin ETF figures, a steady stream of inflows builds confidence and liquidity. Comparing ETH ETF Inflows to the Crypto ETF Landscape How do these early Crypto ETF inflows for Ethereum stack up against the experience with spot Bitcoin ETFs? Bitcoin ETFs saw massive inflows shortly after their launch in January, quickly accumulating billions of dollars in assets under management. Ethereum ETFs are still in their nascent stages, having received regulatory approval more recently and with actual trading expected to commence later. The current inflows, while positive, are smaller than the initial frenzy seen with Bitcoin ETFs. However, this could be due to various factors, including market conditions, the specific timing of their trading launch, and differing investor appetites for ETH versus Bitcoin exposure. The key takeaway is that capital is indeed flowing into the Ethereum ETF space, adding a new dimension to the overall ETF inflows narrative in the crypto market. What Potential Benefits and Challenges Do These Inflows Present? The emergence of significant US spot ETH ETFs inflows brings both opportunities and potential hurdles: Benefits: Increased Accessibility: Makes investing in Ethereum easier for traditional investors and institutions. Potential Price Support: Sustained buying through ETFs can add upward pressure on the ETH price . Market Legitimacy: The approval and adoption of these products by major financial institutions like BlackRock lend further credibility to Ethereum and the broader crypto market. Enhanced Liquidity: Increased trading volume and assets under management in ETFs can improve market liquidity. Challenges: Market Volatility: While inflows can support prices, the crypto market remains inherently volatile, and ETFs are not immune to price swings. Competition: The ETF market is competitive, with multiple issuers vying for assets. Regulatory Uncertainty: Although the ETFs are approved, the broader regulatory landscape for cryptocurrencies can still evolve. Grayscale Dynamics: Managing outflows from the existing Grayscale ETHE fund remains a factor influencing net flows across the ecosystem. Looking Ahead: What’s Next for Ethereum ETFs? The trend of positive ETF inflows is certainly encouraging for Ethereum proponents. As these funds become more established and potentially begin trading, we could see increased interest and larger capital allocations. The performance of BlackRock’s ETHA and other funds will be closely watched as indicators of institutional and retail demand. Continued inflows could provide a tailwind for the ETH price , but market-wide factors, regulatory developments, and overall economic conditions will also play significant roles. Investors interested in this space should monitor the inflow data, track the performance of individual ETFs, and stay informed about the evolving market dynamics. Compelling Summary The $19.1 million net inflow into US spot ETH ETFs on June 18, marking the third consecutive day of positive flows, is a clear indicator that investor interest in Ethereum through regulated investment products is growing. Led by BlackRock and Grayscale’s mini ETH, these inflows suggest increasing accessibility and potential support for the ETH price . While early compared to Bitcoin ETF performance, the trend is positive and adds a new layer of institutional and retail participation to the Ethereum ecosystem. As the market matures, tracking these ETF inflows will be crucial for understanding capital movement and sentiment in the crypto space. title: Pro-Israel hackers deliver on threat to release Nobitex's source code
body: A pro-Israel hacking collective has followed through on its promise to release the full source code of Nobitex, Iran’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, just a day after orchestrating a high-profile blockchain exploit involving more than $100 million in digital assets. The group known as Gonjeshke Darande, also referred to as Predatory Sparrow , published a post on social media platform X on Thursday confirming the release of Nobitex’s internal data. “ Time’s up, full source code linked below. ASSETS LEFT IN NOBITEX ARE NOW ENTIRELY OUT IN THE OPEN ,” the post read. Hacker releases blockchain script post $100 million exploit The leak, posted on an X thread, included components of the platform’s infrastructure such as blockchain scripts , internal privacy configurations, and a list of servers. Cybersecurity analysts say the disclosure effectively cripples the back-end security of Nobitex, leaving any remaining assets on the exchange vulnerable to further attacks. Time's up – full source code linked below. ASSETS LEFT IN NOBITEX ARE NOW ENTIRELY OUT IN THE OPEN. بازمانده دارایی های شما در نوبیتکس هم اکنون در معرض دید و خطر هستند But before that, lets meet Nobitex from the inside: Exchange Deployment (1/8) pic.twitter.com/jiMfBpNXwd — Gonjeshke Darande (@GonjeshkeDarand) June 19, 2025 The source code release follows through on threats issued a day earlier, when the group claimed responsibility for a coordinated attack across multiple blockchain networks. According to the statement, the group’s motivation stemmed from Nobitex’s alleged role in assisting the Iranian government in bypassing international sanctions . They labeled the exchange as “the regime’s favorite sanctions violation tool.” Predatory Sparrow has taken credit for other cyberattacks in recent days, including one targeting Iran’s state-owned Bank Sepah. $100M in crypto burned, not stolen On Wednesday, blockchain analytics firms Chainalysis and Elliptic confirmed that approximately $100 million worth of crypto assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin, Solana, Tron, and Toncoin, were impacted in the heist. According to Chainalysis’s head of national security intelligence, Andrew Fierman, the stolen assets were sent to burner wallets, cryptographic addresses that the attackers cannot access. Analysts believe the funds were not stolen for profit but were instead destroyed to send a political message. “ The motive for stealing the $90+ million in funds is for something other than financial gain ,” Fierman stated, calling the act symbolic and destructive. Elliptic’s analysis also supports this interpretation, noting the use of provocatively named vanity wallets such as “1FuckiRGCTerroristsNoBiTEXXXaAovLX” and “DFuckiRGCTerroristsNoBiTEXXXWLW65t.” These addresses appear to have been created with brute-force generators and lack recoverable private keys, likely a deliberate effort to make the funds irretrievable. Yehor Rudytsia, a security researcher at blockchain firm Hacken, said the choice of wallet addresses used in the attack was more “political” than a typical financial theft. “ The wallet names and behavior suggest a political statement rather than a financially motivated theft ,” Rudytsia said. He added that most of the assets, over 20 different tokens on EVM-compatible chains, were sent to clean burner addresses. “ The only potential for partial recovery lies with Tether, which could reissue the $55 million in stolen USDT ,” he explained. Nobitex responded to the developments on Thursday, saying that no additional losses occurred following the data leak. The exchange announced plans to restore services within five days, although ongoing internet disruptions inside Iran may slow recovery efforts. Exchange linked to Iranian military and militant groups The hacker has claimed Nobitex is connected to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), a military organization designated as a terrorist entity by the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, and Canada. Research by Elliptic has previously linked Nobitex to ransomware operatives sanctioned for ties to the IRGC, and individuals with close affiliations to Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Blockchain data also shows transactional activity between Nobitex wallets and accounts connected to groups including Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, and Yemen’s Houthi movement. title: Iran Says It Will Take Extraordinary Measures Following Israeli Attack on Cryptocurrency Exchanges – Here’s What It Is
body: Following a massive cyberattack on the country’s largest cryptocurrency exchange Nobitex, the Central Bank of Iran has restricted the operating hours of local crypto exchanges. According to the new regulation, exchanges will only be able to trade between 10:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. The restriction comes after an attack on the Tehran-based Nobitex exchange in which more than $90 million worth of crypto assets were stolen. The attack was claimed by the pro-Israeli hacker group Gonjeshke Darande (Predatory Sparrow). The group announced on X (formerly Twitter) that they had infiltrated Nobitex’s infrastructure and threatened to release the platform’s source code and internal data. The same group had also announced an attack on state-owned Bank Sepah the day before. Related News: Massive Whale Gives Up: Sells Last Remaining Holdings in This Altcoin, Suffers Losses According to cybersecurity companies, the attackers did not use the stolen funds for profit. On the contrary, they irreversibly “burned” the assets, that is, they made them inaccessible by transferring them to wallets for which they did not have the private key. Some of these wallets contained insulting statements against the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, suggesting that the attack was not financial but political. Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic confirmed that more than $90 million in assets from Nobitex were transferred to these “burn” wallets, while Chainalysis found the incident to be in line with a pattern of cyberattacks frequently seen during periods of heightened Israeli-Iranian tensions. *This is not investment advice. title: Crypto Asset Managers See Astonishing Surge in On-Chain Holdings
body: BitcoinWorld Crypto Asset Managers See Astonishing Surge in On-Chain Holdings A remarkable trend is unfolding in the digital asset space, one that signals growing confidence and sophistication among professional players. Crypto asset managers , the firms specializing in navigating the volatile world of digital currencies and blockchain technology, have dramatically increased their presence directly on the blockchain. This isn’t just about holding Bitcoin or Ethereum in a digital wallet; it’s about actively deploying capital within decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, contributing to a significant surge in on-chain holdings . What’s Driving the Astonishing Surge in Crypto Asset Managers ‘ On-Chain Holdings? The data is compelling. According to a report by Artemis and Vaults, cited by Cointelegraph, the total capital held on-chain by crypto-native asset managers has quadrupled since the start of the year, climbing from a notable $1 billion in January to over $4 billion currently. This isn’t a minor fluctuation; it’s a substantial reallocation and growth of capital. Several factors appear to be contributing to this trend: Market Recovery and Maturation: Following a prolonged bear market, the crypto space has shown signs of recovery and increasing stability. This renewed confidence encourages managers to deploy capital more aggressively. Search for Yield: Traditional finance continues to grapple with low-yield environments. DeFi offers potentially attractive yields through lending, staking, and liquidity provision, enticing managers looking for returns. Growing Confidence in DeFi Protocols: As DeFi infrastructure matures and undergoes more audits and real-world testing, professional managers are becoming more comfortable interacting directly with these protocols, despite the inherent risks. Demand for Diversification: Within the crypto landscape, DeFi offers a different risk/reward profile compared to simply holding spot assets. Managers can diversify their strategies by participating in various on-chain activities. Operational Efficiency (for some strategies): For certain complex strategies like yield farming or arbitrage, direct on-chain interaction is necessary and can offer operational advantages over relying solely on centralized exchanges or intermediaries. Understanding On-Chain Holdings : Active Participation in the Digital Economy For asset managers, on-chain holdings represent more than just static ownership. It signifies active participation in the decentralized digital economy. Instead of simply holding private keys and waiting for price appreciation, managers are interacting with smart contracts to: Lend Assets: Depositing cryptocurrencies into lending protocols (like the nearly $2 billion locked in Morpho Protocol mentioned in the report) to earn interest paid by borrowers. Borrow Assets: Utilizing collateralized borrowing for leverage, shorting, or capital efficiency. Provide Liquidity: Contributing pairs of assets to decentralized exchanges (DEXs) to facilitate trading and earn a portion of trading fees. Stake Cryptocurrencies: Participating in Proof-of-Stake consensus mechanisms to secure networks and earn staking rewards. Engage in Yield Farming: Pursuing complex strategies involving multiple protocols to maximize returns, often by providing liquidity or staking LP tokens. This direct interaction means managers must possess sophisticated technical capabilities, robust security practices for managing private keys, and a deep understanding of smart contract risks. Where Are These Significant Crypto Investments Flowing? The quadrupling of crypto investments on-chain indicates capital is being spread across a variety of decentralized applications. While the report specifically highlights Morpho Protocol, it’s important to understand the broader landscape where these funds are likely being deployed: Key DeFi Sectors Attracting Capital: Decentralized Lending & Borrowing: Protocols like Aave, Compound, and Morpho remain foundational. They offer relatively stable (though still volatile compared to TradFi) yield opportunities. Morpho’s focus on peer-to-peer matching alongside pool-based lending seems to be particularly attractive, evidenced by the substantial capital locked there. Decentralized Exchanges (DEXs) & Liquidity Provision: Uniswap, Curve, Balancer, and others require liquidity for efficient trading. Asset managers can earn fees by providing this liquidity, though they face the risk of impermanent loss. Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs): Protocols like Lido, Rocket Pool, and others allowing users to stake assets (especially ETH) while receiving a liquid token representing their staked position. This allows managers to earn staking yield while keeping capital flexible for other DeFi activities. Yield Aggregators & Optimizers: Platforms like Yearn Finance or Convex Finance automate yield farming strategies across various protocols, aiming to maximize returns but often adding layers of smart contract risk. The allocation across these diverse opportunities reflects a strategic approach by managers to capture different types of yield and manage varying levels of risk within the DeFi ecosystem. The Pivotal Role of DeFi (Decentralized Finance) in This Growth Story The surge in on-chain holdings by professional managers is intrinsically linked to the growth and evolution of DeFi (Decentralized Finance) . DeFi provides the infrastructure, the protocols, and the opportunities that make direct on-chain capital deployment attractive and feasible. Its core tenets – transparency (transactions are verifiable on a public ledger), accessibility (permissionless interaction), and innovation – are key draws. However, DeFi is not without its significant risks. Smart contract vulnerabilities can lead to hacks and loss of funds. Protocol governance can be unpredictable. Market volatility can cause rapid liquidations or impermanent loss. Regulatory uncertainty hangs over the entire space. Professional managers engaging with DeFi must navigate these complexities with rigorous risk management frameworks. Implications for Broader Institutional Crypto Adoption While the report focuses on crypto-native firms, their increasing comfort and capital deployment in DeFi is a significant signal. These firms often act as pioneers, testing the waters and building the infrastructure and expertise that could eventually pave the way for broader institutional crypto adoption from traditional finance players. The lessons learned, the risk management strategies developed, and the operational workflows established by crypto-native managers are invaluable blueprints. The growth in on-chain holdings suggests that a segment of professional investors sees a long-term future in decentralized protocols and believes the potential rewards outweigh the risks, provided they are managed effectively. This trend validates the utility and potential of the underlying blockchain technology and the applications built upon it. Benefits for Asset Managers Operating On-Chain: Potential for higher yields compared to traditional finance or even centralized crypto platforms. Direct control and interaction with assets and protocols. Transparency of on-chain transactions (though counterparty identity may be pseudonymous). Access to a wide range of innovative financial primitives and strategies. Participation in network governance (for some protocols). Challenges and Risks: Significant security risks (smart contract bugs, exploits, private key management). Regulatory uncertainty and potential compliance hurdles. Operational complexity and need for specialized technical expertise. Market volatility and potential for rapid, significant losses (e.g., liquidations, impermanent loss). Liquidity issues in smaller or newer protocols. Tax and accounting complexities for on-chain activities. Actionable Insights for the Curious Investor What can the average person take away from this trend? The fact that professional crypto asset managers are significantly increasing their on-chain holdings in DeFi is a strong indicator that sophisticated capital sees value and opportunity in this space. However, it’s crucial to understand that these managers have dedicated teams, advanced tools, and significant risk capital. For individual investors considering engaging with DeFi or exploring crypto investments , this trend highlights the importance of: Thorough Research: Understand the specific protocols you interact with. Read audits, understand the mechanics, and assess the team. Risk Management: Never invest more than you can afford to lose. Be aware of smart contract risk, impermanent loss, and liquidation risk. Security: Learn how to secure your private keys and interact safely with web3 wallets. Starting Small: If exploring DeFi, begin with small amounts to understand how protocols work before committing significant capital. Staying Informed: Keep up with developments in the DeFi space and the broader regulatory landscape. A Compelling Trend: The Future is On-Chain The quadrupling of on-chain holdings by crypto asset managers since January is more than just a statistic; it’s a powerful signal. It demonstrates a growing professionalization and institutional comfort level with direct interaction on the blockchain, particularly within the DeFi (Decentralized Finance) ecosystem. This trend in crypto investments , spearheaded by crypto-native firms, provides valuable insights into where sophisticated capital sees future opportunities and challenges, potentially accelerating the path towards broader institutional crypto adoption . As the infrastructure matures and regulatory clarity hopefully improves, we may see this trend continue, further blurring the lines between traditional finance and the decentralized digital economy.
